76:t_013:9.en:
$$柿小路$$
「But $$勝平$$, did you and the others know we were here?」

76:t_013:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah. Dad heard some news about the $$残されの海$$.」

76:t_013:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「Oh, right. My family... The whole $$神ファミリー$$ is on this Earth.」

76:t_013:13.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$勝平$$'s father is the captain of a deep-sea fishing vessel...」

76:t_013:14.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「He heard from his friends at sea that battleships and robots came to the $$残されの海$$ and fought pirates.」

76:t_013:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「So I figured it must be our friends from 《$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$》 and 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》, and came all this way in $$ザンボット３$$.」

76:t_013:16.en:
$$恵子$$
「Hey, $$勝平$$...! Don't forget to tell them the important part!」

76:t_013:18.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「We have a message from $$万丈$$ about the coming battles against $$サイデリアル$$.」

76:t_013:20.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The famous man of action, $$破嵐万丈$$...」

76:t_013:21.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What exactly does his message say...?」

76:t_100:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I request an explanation of the situation.」

76:t_100:1.en:
$$レド$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is the Alliance's enemy. If they attack us, intercepting them is the natural decision.」

76:t_100:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Question. Until recently, you considered yourself worthless as an Alliance soldier.」

76:t_100:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Why, then, do you now seek to fulfill your duties as an Alliance soldier?」

76:t_100:4.en:
$$レド$$
「...I'll figure out the answer to that from here on.」

76:t_100:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Then did you order this unit into combat without firm grounds for your decision or a sense of purpose?」

76:t_100:6.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll figure out the answer to that, too!」

76:t_101:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「So I was right...! He's the new 《$$スフィア・リアクター$$》!」

76:t_101:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! The enemy seems to know you're a $$リアクター$$!」

76:t_101:2.en:
$n
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$ was one of them. It's only natural, when you think about it.」

76:t_101:4.en:
$n
「I don't give a damn about their circumstances. There's just one thing I'm going to do...」

76:t_101:5.en:
$n
「I'll show them who now owns the $$スフィア$$ that used to be their weapon, and that its owner is their worst enemy!」

76:t_102:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's $$ザンボット３$$ with one of the $$ビアル$$'s ion engines for you! Its power's on a whole different level now!」

76:t_102:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「$$勝平$$! Don't let that power throw you around!」

76:t_102:2.en:
$$恵子$$
「Don't forget we're here representing the $$神ファミリー$$!」

76:t_102:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「I know! $$サイデリアル$$ making everyone suffer, that mysterious robot army...」

76:t_102:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Me and $$ザンボット３$$ will take them all on at once!!」

76:t_103:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I can't let $$勝平$$ show me up! Me and $$トライダー$$ are going in, too!!」

76:t_103:1.en:
$$郁絵$$
「The President... looks happy to see $$勝平$$ and the others again.」

76:t_103:2.en:
$$厚井$$
「He looked awfully lonely when $$勝平$$ and the others had to return to $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

76:t_103:3.en:
$$木下$$
「It's as though the flower of friendship has burst into bloom!」

76:t_103:4.en:
$$柿小路$$
「With them here, we're a hundred times stronger! We'll follow their lead!!」

76:t_103:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here we come, robot army! Don't think you can stop us now!!」

ビアル.evidence: 76:t_102:0 short form of King Beal mothership; Zambot is fitted with one of its ion engines.

リアクター.evidence: 76:t_101:0-2 abbreviated Sphere Reactor, referring to Hibiki as the new owner.

kept_omissions: 76:t_013:19: Watta echoes the message sender in surprise.
76:t_013:20: Tessa contemplatively identifies Banjo by reputation.
76:t_102:3: list of enemies continues into the next row.
context_decisions: 76:t_101:1 Suzune identifies Hibiki as the Reactor rather than herself; preceding Gilter line and Hibiki's reply settle referent.
76:t_101:4-5 retains Hibiki's unsoftened dismissal and full threat about the stolen Sphere.
76:t_103:4 hundred times stronger preserves the force of the encouragement idiom.
